name: Riedel Glas Manufaktur
kurzbeschreibung: The Riedel Glass factory in Kufstein showcases the art of mouth-blown crystal glassware and the multisensory Sinnfonie exhibition.
preis: Sinnfonie exhibition: adults approx. €8.00, children up to 14 free (large factory outlet store)
oeffnungszeiten: Monday to Friday 09:30–16:00, Saturday 09:30–14:00 (closed Sundays & public holidays)
beschreibung:
Overview

The world-renowned Riedel Glass Factory (Riedel Glas Manufaktur) in Kufstein stands as the ultimate global benchmark for varietal-specific crystal wine glasses and handcrafted mouth-blown decanters. Family-owned for eleven generations, this historic enterprise revolutionized international wine appreciation through the scientific discovery that the shape, rim diameter, and bowl curvature of a glass decisively shape the bouquet and palate of fine wines. At its headquarters in Kufstein, guests can witness firsthand how molten quartz sand is transformed into world-class glassware for sommeliers and gourmets through traditional artisan methods.

Route & Requirements

The tour comprises two captivating highlights: In the multimedia exhibition Sinnfonie, visitors' senses are awakened through an imaginative choreography of light, sound, and glass celebrating over 250 years of family craftsmanship. Subsequently, an elevated visitor gallery leads directly into the glowing Glassworks (Schauhütte). Looking down from above, guests watch master glassblowers gather red-hot molten glass from melting furnaces on long blowing pipes, blow it into cherry-wood molds, and expertly pull fragile crystal stems by hand. The tour follows broad galleries, is completely wheelchair accessible, and can be enjoyed effortlessly in casual footwear in any weather.

Visit & Arrival

The Glassworks and Sinnfonie exhibition are open Monday through Friday from 09:30 to 16:00, and Saturday from 09:30 to 14:00 (production rests on Sundays and public holidays). Admission to the Sinnfonie is approx. €8.00 for adults, while children up to age 14 accompanied by an adult enter free. By train: from Kufstein central station, local town buses run in minutes to the stop Kufstein Weissach / Riedel Glas; walking takes approx. twenty minutes. Drivers take the A12 motorway (exit Kufstein Süd) and reach the factory grounds with ample free customer parking within two minutes.

Tips

In the expansive adjacent Riedel Outlet Store, visitors discover the world's largest selection of first-choice glassware, factory seconds, and rare collector decanters at attractive prices. For wine enthusiasts, specialized Glass Tasting Workshops can be booked in advance, demonstrating how dramatically the same wine tastes in different glass shapes. A stylish café on site serves aromatic coffees and snacks.
